h: True Torah Dispute Must Preserve Friendship and Peace

p: כַּד בָּרָא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא עָלְמָא
"When Hakadosh Baruch Hu created the world,
of the upper and the lower beings;
and then the world endured, etc."
is called in the holy Zohar "peace,"
כִּי כֹל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כט, יא)
"for all that is in the heavens and on the earth" (Divrei HaYamim I 29:11),
is that there be the unity
and peace of the upper and lower beings,
"Why is 'that it was good' not written
Because on it dispute was created,
'And let it divide between water and water.'
that is for the rectification of the world
has no 'that it was good,' etc."
is the light that is good,
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
"And God saw the light, that it was good."
regarding all the works of creation,
"And God saw that it was good":
that is, that there is in it
when there was created a separation
"that it was good" is not said,
for the light that is good is not in it,
since there is not in it
the peace of the upper and lower beings,
is for the rectification of the world.
it is stated in the Zohar Chadash
and counted the Mussaf of Shabbos
which is the attribute of peace.
is "the spreading of the Sukkah of peace
הַיּוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּגַּנִּים וְכוּלֵּי (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ח, יג)
"'You who dwell in the gardens, etc.' (Shir HaShirim 8:13):
שֶׁלֹּא תִּשְׂנְאוּ זֶה אֶת זֶה וְכוּלֵּי
not to hate one another, etc."
And the holy Zohar further says:
for he was gathering wood, etc."
הֵי מִינַיְיהוּ רַב עַל אָחֳרָא וְכוּלֵּי
which of them is greater than the other, etc.
is called the Tree of Life,
at the beginning of Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu
regarding the Tree of Life of Gan Eden:
they would have been given only
the five books of the Torah, etc.,"
and this alone would have sufficed,
and they would have known everything
as it will be in the future,
for they shall all know Me, etc."
from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil,
and as is written in the holy Zohar
but it is for the rectification of the world.
that the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil
is superior to the Tree of Life,
And this is what it says,
"And Yisrael encamped there opposite the mountain"
like one man with one heart
and then they merited Mattan Torah,
And even in Torah she'b'al peh,
it is for the rectification of the world,
"Even a father and his son, etc.,
and they do not move from there
עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשִׂין אוֹהֲבִים זֶה אֶת זֶה וְכוּלֵּי
until they become beloved of one another, etc."
And the holy Zohar says earlier:
is the opposite of peace, etc."
that the dispute would do no harm;
that he intended only for the sake of Heaven;
because the conduct of his fellow
does not seem right in his eyes,
the dispute would do no harm in this.
are bound one with the other"
And in the dispute of Shammai and Hillel,
which was truly for the sake of Heaven,
even at the time of their dispute
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ח, יב)
But when there are grievances in the heart
that is not for the rectification of the world
and bringing them close to Torah" (Avos 1:12);
that is, that his power was
to bring the words of Torah
"For the lips of the kohen guard knowledge,
and Torah they shall seek from his mouth";

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemot Rabbah 1:26 — “… כבד פה וכבד לשון. ותקרא שמו משה, מכאן אתה למד שכרן של גומלי חסדים, אף על פי שהרבה שמות היו לו למשה, לא נקבע לו שם בכל התורה אלא כמו …” — ““The child grew and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he was a son to her. She named him Moses and she said: Because I drew him from the water” (Exodus 2:10). “The child grew.” She nursed him for …”
